title: Hooke’s law
target: Connect spring displacement with restoring force.
criteria: Measure displacement from the natural length.
Point the spring force back toward equilibrium.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A spring’s natural length is 15 cm and its stretched length is 19 cm. What is extension x in meters?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A spring is compressed from its natural length of 30 cm to 27 cm. What is the compression magnitude?
cpa.guide: Compression is the 3 cm change from natural length.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 9 N force stretches an ideal spring by 0.03 m. What is k?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: An ideal spring with k = 80 N/m is stretched 0.05 m. What is restoring-force magnitude?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A spring is stretched to the right from equilibrium. In which direction does it pull the attached object?
options: It exerts no force until released.
cpa.guide: The restoring force opposes displacement from equilibrium.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A student writes F = +kx for the spring’s force when positive x points away from equilibrium. What correction is needed?
options: Set k negative for every spring.
Replace displacement with total spring length.
Use F = −kx for the restoring force.
cpa.guide: With that sign convention, spring force is opposite x; k remains positive.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
